A new update has arrived, bringing intense new challenges to Darkzan Arena!

Horde Mode
Prepare yourself for relentless combat! In this new mode, you will face endless waves of enemies with no breaks between attacks. Zombies, slimes, spiders, and all kinds of creatures will relentlessly try to take you down. Survive as long as you can and prove your strength!

New difficulty settings have been added, allowing for more customized and challenging gameplay.

Get ready for the chaos—can you withstand the horde?

notes.title: Darkzan Arena Oblivion - Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Darkzan Arena Oblivion - Update[/h1]
Get ready for a new experience filled with improvements, adjustments, and additions!  

[h3]What's New[/h3]
- 🚀 New Steam achievements and in-game achievements have been added. Show your power to everyone!  
- 🆕 Two new items added: Quiver and Scabbard.  
  - These items have unique special abilities that will expand your combat strategies.  
- 🌟 Addition of Rank Plus:  
  - Arena difficulty now scales automatically every 100 enemies defeated. Test your limits!  
- 🛡️ Physical attacks can now block and deflect projectiles and certain spells!  
- ⚡ Visual lightning effects added to arenas, increasing combat immersion.  

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- 🎨 Re-sprites applied to several important characters for greater visual impact.  
- ☁️ Adjustments made to Steam Cloud for improved progress storage stability.  
- 🎮 Steam rich presence in the Arena updated, now showing detailed information about your game session.  
- 📦 Inventory filters added for better organization and item management.  
- 🤖 Enemy AI has been improved, making them more challenging and strategic.  
- 🕺 Player and enemy animations have been improved, providing smoother and more realistic movements.  

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
- ✊ Physical attack collisions now push attackers back, increasing realism and impact.  
- 🛡️ Fixed the shield limit for some enemies to ensure more consistent combat behavior.  
- ⚔️ Weapon damage for certain weapons has been adjusted to achieve better balance across playstyles.  

See you in the Arena, fighters! 💥  
Prepare yourselves for new challenges and enjoy all the improvements!  

[i]MrBoscheinen[/i]

notes.title: Darkzan Arena Oblivion Patch - Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Darkzan Arena Oblivion Patch - Update Notes[/h1]  
Greetings, Arena warriors!  
The [b]Oblivion Patch[/b]   is here, bringing new challenges, improvements, and adjustments that will elevate your arena experience. Get ready to face the legendary Darkzan and explore a universe of epic possibilities. Check out the changes below:

[b]Update Highlights[/b]  
- 🔥 [b]Face Darkzan in Wave 100[/b]  
The ultimate arena challenge is finally here! Prepare to battle Darkzan and prove your worth.  

- 🎒 [b]Inventory Expansion with Backpacks[/b]  
Backpacks now increase the inventory limit, allowing you to carry more items into battle.  

- 🛠️ [b]Improvements to Forging[/b]  
Rank and Item Modifier display has been added directly to the forging screen, making the system more intuitive.  

- 🌟 [b]Improved Mastery System[/b]  
Masteries now drop every **10 enemies defeated in a row**, rewarding your skill and consistency.  

[b]New Content[/b]  
- 🛡️ [b]New Armor Effects[/b]  
Added new visual effects and bonuses to armors for greater customization and strategy.  

- 👤 [b]New Character Faces[/b]  
More face options have been added to customize your character’s appearance.  

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]  
- The arena introduction is now **skippable**, allowing you to jump straight into action.  
- A **full inventory alert** has been added to the Log and as a character voice line.  
- **Icons for equipment slots** have been added to the inventory tab for easier navigation and organization.  

[b]Balancing[/b]  
- ⚡ [b]Dash Nerfed[/b]  
Dash distance has been reduced to balance its effectiveness.  

- 🕷️ [b]More Skilled Enemies[/b]  
Enemies now have new abilities, making battles more dynamic and challenging.  

Prepare for epic battles and keep sending us your feedback! See you in the arena!  

[i]MrBoscheinen[/i]

[h3]Mortals, heed my words. I am Darkzan, the embodiment of shadows and keeper of this vast and treacherous realm. Today, I unveil the changes that will shape your existence in my domain.
Your petty struggles in Darkzan Arena have not gone unnoticed. The arena has been reforged in the fires of my will. Its very essence reshaped—performance enhanced, its visage sharpened, and its challenges refined. New trials await you, mortals, alongside balance that ensures only the worthy may prevail.
But do not think my work is done. Throughout the coming cycle of your years, the Arena shall evolve further. Monthly, I shall cast down new content into your grasp, a deluge of trials and rewards to test your mettle. Prepare yourselves, for the shadows never rest.
The realms of Darkzan Doom and Gekido have not escaped my grasp. They, too, shall bow to my new design. Their worlds will adapt to a progressive system, granting you, insignificant as you are, greater control over your own path. Yet, tread carefully, for with freedom comes peril, and your choices shall seal your fate.
Do not forget—all that transpires within my realms is bound by a shared lore. Each event, each battle, each triumph or failure—all are threads in the grand tapestry of Darkzan. The secrets you uncover will bind you deeper to the shadows, revealing truths both wondrous and terrible.
Prepare yourselves, mortals, for the future of Darkzan is upon you. Step into the shadows, embrace the unknown, and prove your worth—if you dare. My realm awaits. [/h3]

Many bugs were fixed, functions implemented and slimes slaughtered.

[b]Stamina: [/b]Many players found it difficult to dodge attacks and maintain good use of stamina in the arena, so for the common good, the cost of Dash is now 20% of total stamina instead of 50% as it was before.

[b]Interface: [/b]The game now has several text indications and icons to make it easier to understand the progress.
A Gamelog has been added to the lower left corner where item collection, quests, autosave and other functions are announced.
Released structures now have an icon arrow to make it easier for new players to find and discover them.
Pause menu tabs now contain text to indicate functionality.

[b]Game guide:[/b] A complete guide on Darkzan Arena is being developed and will be published in the steam community tab, I will announce its release in the future.

That's it for now, stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: DevLog 02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/bd443b96f6ea680e00f9521a9945161d7a3ec9d6.png[/img]
[h1] NEWS[/h1]
Hello to all Darkzan Arena challengers, I'm here to inform you of a big, giant, massive update.
dozens of new features, bug fixes, balances and more!

[h1] THE BANK[/h1]
Starting at the beginning, we now have a Bank system to store your items, the vault has 400 empty spaces and can store anything, great for item collectors or compulsive hoarders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/d4904605cffd78052fc2b2e2d414a4cf9bed2dd0.jpg[/img]

[h1]REMATCH/h1]
You know that annoying challenger that always defeats you? now you can call him for a rematch and he will face you directly in the Arena, the fights will continue until you lose or give up, this is very useful to farm a specific set or simply for revenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/fde6b96c08a5959be03e2e67b04379149c28e95f.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE STREET VENDOR[/h1]
Now you can make a profit much easier by selling your old items to the street vendor! He also sells some pretty useful stuff so it's always good to check it out, we just don't know how he gets to and from the Nexus so easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/14f35b9b45305b365cb87e5c3c4c3d7a84e54b71.jpg[/img]

[h1]CURSOR[/h1]
Thinking about the immersion I decided to change the mouse cursor to something more subtle and integrated into the interface, now it has a unique elegance, I hope you like it.

[h1]STEAM CLOUD[/h1]
Great news for steam users, I've added the cloud save system, now your files won't be lost in the vacuum of space and your save will be protected!

[h1]NEW CHALLENGERS[/h1]
A new wave of challenges awaits you, a considerable number of new enemies have been added, kings, princesses, invaders from another world... they await you in the Darkzan Arena!

Thank you to everyone who is trusting and putting so much love into the project, as always I'm doing my best to deliver the best game possible!

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/945e3d030a4df84e090262f218b6d2e390ad4476.png[/img]

What the game is, in short, it's an arcade of survival in waves, hordes of enemies appear and the player has to survive until the next one. 
Each Horde has its own theme, Bees, Warriors, Goblins, etc. 
Each creature can drop equipment that can be used by the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/368c39851ff26db2e5752defd85e3863bafe0989.gif[/img]

Despite its simple idea of ​​game mechanics are many and complex, starting with the primary weapons, They have 3 attacks activated according to the distance of the mouse cursor from the avatar.
Their combat variations are very different allowing different combinations and playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/6b940e19a85f114a0a6a20e2e8ba0ad3d7408cfc.gif[/img]

Your secondary equipment is much more complex in terms of functionality, things like shields, summoning books, food and potions have a charge time and cause a totally different effect from primary weapons, healing, protections, buffs and several other functions will be present in these items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/9047bfe4a5cb4bdd202b75748c50bf0571339a60.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/8e0be02833f7f05dbcfbe511e4a33ea8bb41943c.png[/img]

Armor is a key part of progressing in the game, here every piece of equipment has unique effects on, defense, magic defense, speed, status regeneration, knockback resistance and enchantments.
A considerable amount of items can be collected from your enemies, acquired through chests or craft and their combinations are practically endless.
A total of 3 armor slots will be available for use, Head, Body and Accessory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/cfffa8f3dcf8b5a69efd1a24f510a044037da685.png[/img]

Enchanted items are an excellent way to get stronger.
For weapons an additional effect is placed on their attacks, being able to generate lifesteal, explosions, regeneration, multiplied attacks and many others.
For armor the effect is activated when your magic defense is activated, giving in response some attack, improvement in status or regeneration.
The accessory activates its enchantment when the player performs a Dash, a considerable amount of effects can lead you to victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/40fff77c807cea1bc801763fe4edab772e3b8dd6.gif[/img]

Beware of the Challengers, as in every arena, here will emerge the best of the best, the most powerful magicians, legendary pirates, warriors from another time, thirsty for challenges and opponents at the height, will you be able to face them face to face?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/79280e3f2796bee43788706a60e21287ba06a378.png[/img]

Currently the game has more than 20 races of creatures, each with a very different culture and style, movement, elements, equipment are special in their own way.
It is even possible to change your face at the occultist NPC at the cost of some soul coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/f97cc38f7322dbfd94f82116b9f0a1aa61f8375f.png[/img]

You will be in the nexus, the center of all creation, where the mightiest challengers and the most sinister creatures gather to do battle, the universe will tremble before the arena. But pay attention to every detail, this place also hides terrible secrets and is full of mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/b86fe8ee46c530841b87381669d98b347ec7cd75.png[/img]
A free demo will be available soon, it will have a limitation on the amount of items and bosses but it is possible to enjoy the game mechanics and feel if this is the fun you are looking for.
This free demo also serves as a starting point for the community, put Darkzan on your wishlist, show it to your friends, let's create a rich and complex universe together, many adventures are to come, will you stay out?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642847/bd443b96f6ea680e00f9521a9945161d7a3ec9d6.png[/img]

The development team is basically me, Bosch, I have a little experience with games and design, graduated in illustration and cinema.
If you have any ideas or comments don't hesitate to contact me through the Darkzan community on steam! I intend to make the best game possible and that everyone can have fun!
